connectors.activationHint: The site owner must approve BranchHarbor in Mindbody. Send them this link, then re-authorise here.
connectors.chooseLocationHint: This {name} account has several locations. Choose the one that sells for this location.
connectors.rule1: Each location has exactly one gross-sales source: BranchHarbor payments, one connector, or a self-reported figure with evidence.
connectors.rule2: Connectors sync every night (the last three days) and on demand. Days are stored in the location’s time zone and currency; other currencies are kept apart, never converted.
connectors.rule3: Self-reported figures are compared with connector data where both exist, and differences above the threshold are flagged on the statement.

bench.title: Network benchmarks
bench.description: See how your network compares with similar networks, anonymously. Off until HQ opts in.
bench.cardOff: Take part in anonymised benchmarks to see where your network stands against similar networks.
bench.cardWaiting: Benchmarks appear once at least {k} similar networks take part.
bench.on: Your network takes part in benchmarks
bench.onSince: Taking part since {when}. Opting out deletes your contributions.
bench.offBody: Share anonymised monthly figures to see percentiles against similar networks. Only networks that take part can see benchmarks.
bench.optOutConfirm: Stop taking part? Your contributions are deleted and you will no longer see benchmarks.
bench.waiting: Not enough similar networks yet: a figure is shown once at least {k} networks contribute.
bench.noData: No figure for your network this month
bench.cohortLine: Similar networks: lower quartile {p25} · median {p50} · upper quartile {p75} · about {size} networks ({scope})
bench.privacy1: Only one figure per network, month and measure is shared: no location names, customers or individual sales.
bench.privacy2: Nothing about a group of networks is shown until at least {k} networks contribute, and group sizes are rounded.
bench.privacy3: Published figures carry statistical noise, fixed per month, so they cannot be averaged away or traced back to one network.
bench.privacy4: Revenue is only compared within one currency and never converted.
bench.privacy5: Taking part is off by default, and opting out deletes your contributions immediately.
